Hmm, that doesn't sound right because I remember that the 2014 World Cup was actually hosted by Brazil.

Wait, let me think. I'm pretty sure that Brazil hosted the 2014 World Cup. So if the WebSurfer said that the host was South Africa, that must be a mistake. The WebSurfer should have correctly identified the host country as Brazil. So the mistake was made by the WebSurfer in step 1 when they performed the initial search and reported the wrong host country. The reason for the error is that the WebSurfer either made a mistake in their search or provided incorrect information based on a wrong source.
